integrity: The displayed norm is established by an all-arm finite proof with explicit attaining pairs. The attached LP and rational-data checks corroborate but do not replace that proof. The contribution is an exact two-data stability modulus, not an existence/uniqueness result for extensions. Literature overlap may remain in unindexed sources.
scientific_limitations: Finite scalar-valued compact metric stars with positive arm lengths and canonical absolutely minimizing Lipschitz extension only. The result does not cover multi-junction trees, vector targets, or alternate data norms.
title: Sharp two-point sensitivity of optimal Lipschitz extension on weighted stars
